```plato

//==
// # Warped and derived noises
//
// Noise fields built by feeding one noise through another: domain warping
// displaces the sample position before evaluation, and curl noise takes the
// rotational derivative of a smooth potential to obtain a divergence-free
// vector field.

// Planar domain-warped noise: the sample point is displaced by a warp noise
// of WarpFrequency scaled by WarpStrength, applied Iterations times, before
// evaluating the Basis noise. Produces marbled, fluid-like patterns.
type DomainWarpNoise2D
    implements IValue, IScalarField2D
{
    Basis: NoiseBasis;
    Seed: Integer;
    Frequency: Number;
    WarpStrength: Number;
    WarpFrequency: Number;
    Iterations: Integer;
}
```
